name: python
description: Zero-dependency Python CLI + library package with a src/ layout, for pip and pipx.
notes: Emits 10 files. The generator additionally writes MELODIESPARK_SCAFFOLD.json and extract-audit.jsonl at the destination root; those come from the CLI, not from this template.

The `files` array lists TEMPLATE-SPACE paths, so the package directory appears as src/{{PY_MODULE}}. The CLI renders path segments as well as file contents, so scaffolding into a directory named my-tool emits src/my_tool/ and my_tool.cli:main. `melodie template show <name> --files` prints the same unrendered paths.
Both console scripts are declared: {{CLI_BIN}} (default melodie-app) and {{PY_MODULE}} (default melodie_app). They are the same entry point, exposed under both names so either spelling works.
No imports outside the Python standard library. `import melodie_app` must work in any bare interpreter on Python >= 3.10.
Build backend is setuptools with a src/ layout; `python -m build` produces an sdist and a wheel in dist/.

The PEP 621 `name` is taken verbatim from the target directory name. PEP 508 forbids spaces, so scaffold into a directory named like a valid identifier (or pass --name); the CLI does not normalize it for you.
No [project.urls] section: this scaffold cannot know the real repository or homepage and will not invent URLs.

The install/run strings in this manifest are printed verbatim by `melodie init` and `melodie template show`; the CLI does not substitute {{TOKEN}} in them, so the {{CLI_BIN}} and {{PY_MODULE}} placeholders show up literally in that panel. The README of the generated project is rendered correctly.
Non-web3 template: no wallet, signing, broadcasting, custody or token handling of any kind.
Status of generated projects: SCAFFOLD. Nothing here has been built, tested, audited or deployed.
